title: Lumen Metabolism Reading CO2 Ratio Leaderboard
dataSources: HRV (`hrv:reading`), blood oxygen (`spo2:reading`), lab panels (`bloodpanel:result`), supplements (`supplement:intake`), continuous glucose (`cgm:glucose`), sleep-apnea events (`apnea:event`), body composition (`bodycomp:measure`), blood pressure (`bloodpressure:reading`).
app: Biohacking data — HRV straps, pulse oximeters, blood-pressure cuffs, continuous glucose monitors, body-composition scales, lab-result exports, and supplement logs — ingested to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lumen:metabolism co2_ratio=*
| stats sum(co2_ratio) as total_value, avg(co2_ratio) as avg_value by measurement_time
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks time of day values by total and average co2 ratio across Lumen metabolism reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `co2_ratio` values for each Lumen metabolism reading event and review total and average co2 ratio by time of day.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total co2 ratio.
grandmaExplanation: It helps keep which time of day shows the biggest co2 ratio numbers in your Lumen metabolism reading data.
